تهررن (form I)
# تَهْرِرْنَ (tahrirna) /tah.rir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra)
# تُهْرَرْنَ (tuhrarna) /tuh.rar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
